title: explicit id for label helper
name: Explicit id for label helper
rule: Explicit `id` for label + helper association — input linked to label and helper (`for` / `aria-describedby`). Until hydration, a TextField without an explicit `id` will not have associated labels.
pass_when: TextField has an explicit `id`; label uses `for`; helper is `aria-describedby`.
fail_when: No explicit `id`, so label/helper are not associated (including pre-hydration).
overview: Give Text Field an explicit id so label and helper associate via for and aria-describedby.
apply_when: Wiring MUI Text Field label and helper text associations.
not_when: Not for unlabeled decorative inputs that are not meant to be named fields.
agent_hint: Set an explicit id; link label with for and helper with aria-describedby.
description: A Text Field needs an explicit `id` so the label can use `for` and the helper can use `aria-describedby`. Until hydration, a TextField without an explicit id will not have associated labels, so name and help stay disconnected for assistive tech. Fail when missing id leaves label and helper unassociated, including pre-hydration. Always set the id when wiring label and helper associations on MUI Text Field.
do_not_claim: Visible-label existence (`forms.field_labels.visible_label`) as this association row.
